quotes.text:
“Old longings nomadic leap,
          Chafing at custom's chain;
          Again from its brumal sleep
          Wakens the ferine strain.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “You might wrap up the goods before you deliver 'm,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“I'm
takin' 'm up for the boss to 'Frisco. A crack dog-doctor there thinks
that he can cure 'm.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “All I get is fifty for it,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“an' I wouldn't do it over for
a thousand, cold cash.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “How much did the other mug get?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Wouldn't take a sou less, so help me.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:

he's worth it, or I'm a squarehead.”

quotes.text: “It'll be because you was born to hang,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown
